Which statement about carboxylic acids is correct?
A
They react with alkalis to form a salt and water.
B
They react with metals to form a salt and water.
C
They react with metal carbonates to form a salt, water and hydrogen.
D
The general formula for carboxylic acids is CnH2n+1OH.

options.label: A
options.text: They react with alkalis to form a salt and water.

options.label: B
options.text: They react with metals to form a salt and water.

options.label: C
options.text: They react with metal carbonates to form a salt, water and hydrogen.

options.label: D
options.text: The general formula for carboxylic acids is CnH2n+1OH.
